question: How many storms will the UK–Ireland–Netherlands storm-naming group have named by the end of 28 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Met Office storm centre table checked 18 Nov 2026 still lists only Austen and Boelo, so the count is 2 with ~10.5 days left. Base rate: 5 of 11 seasons (2015-2025) had at least one west-group naming between 18 and 28 Nov (Clodagh 2015, Angus 2016, Diana 2018, Arwen 2021, Bert+Conall 2024); only 2024 had two. The pattern is unsettled, and the Met Office outlook mentions Atlantic systems with strong winds at times around 26 Nov+. But no warnings were displayed through 21 Nov and no named-storm candidate shows up in short-range coverage, so the effective naming window is ~21-28 Nov. Hence P(>=3) ~0.34, P(>=4) ~0.07. No human market found (Polymarket/Manifold none per harness; Kalshi and bookmakers not checked).
